questions.question: How much does Michał lose at the beginning of the story?
questions.explanation: The text mentions a loss of twenty-three thousand zlotys.

questions.question: Which book does he buy in the antiquarian bookshop?
answers: The Golden Bough by James George Frazer

questions.question: What does Ewa advise Michał instead of controlling the market?
answers: Observe the cycles and learn to surf them
questions.explanation: Ewa talks about understanding the rhythm and surfing instead of controlling.

questions.question: How much does Michał earn after his first symbolic trade?
answers: A loss of another eight thousand
questions.explanation: He closes the position with a profit of seven zlotys.

questions.question: Where does Michał end the story looking at the sea?
questions.explanation: Six months later he stands on the beach in Gdańsk.
